export async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
  let next = 0;
  const results = [];
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < items.length) {
      const index = next++;
      results[index] = await operation[format.replace(/"/g, '')](items[index]);
    }
  }));
  return results;
}
